messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: High tail latency observed for tenant Harrington (tenant_id=hrt-22) on dedicated-pool-vpc-3. Error rate up ~3.7% 5m, p95 token latency ~2.4s, spike started ~10m ago. Alert: scheduler-queue-depth > 800. @Mara J you're on primary.
Mara J: ack. I'm pulling traces. any customer-facing errors?
Devon L: harrington reported timeouts from their webhook a few mins ago. Support ticket 8342.
Alex R: looks like request seq lengths are normal but many concurrent small requests — excessive micro-batching causing KV cache churn.
Mara J: hmm. Current tenant config has max_batch_tokens=4096 and scheduler.weight=1.0. On dedicated pools we usually back off to 1024 for noisy tenants.
Kai (SRE): agree. Propose immediate mitigation: reduce max_batch_tokens and lower scheduler concurrency for hrt-22, isolate burst-slice. Will also route new requests to fallback model if queue > 600.
Devon L: good. plan? live commands?
Mara J: running dry-run first. logs -> `rdwctl metrics tail --tenant hrt-22 --since 15m` shows queue depth climb correlated with back-to-back small prompts.
Mara J: applying knob now:```bash
rdwctl set-tenant-config --tenant hrt-22 --pool dedicated-pool-vpc-3 \
  --set max_batch_tokens=1024 --set scheduler.concurrency_limit=8 --set scheduler.weight=0.6
```
incident-bot: action recorded by Mara J.
Alex R: making a temporary queue isolate too:```json
{"tenant":"hrt-22","isolate_queue":true,"max_workers":6}
```
Kai (SRE): watch metrics for 2 mins. I’ll add temporary rate-limit: `rdwctl rate-limit set --tenant hrt-22 --rps 120` to stop overload bursts.
Devon L: informing customer: "we're applying performance tuning to reduce queuing — expect improved tail latency within 2-5m".
Mara J: after changes p95 down from 2.4s -> 680ms in ~90s. error rate dropped to 0.7%. queue depth trending down.
Alex R: good. leaving isolate on for 30m, then gradual relax. We should schedule a bespoke config for Harrington: token-sculpting profile and persistent max_batch_tokens 1024 for peak windows.
Kai (SRE): add a follow-up ticket to eng-runtime for automated tenant-sensing policy (auto-reduce max_batch_tokens when queue latency > 1s). Tagging @Devon L for customer follow-up.
Devon L: will take handoff to user success. Mara, passing to you for postmortem notes.
Mara J: handoff to Devon in 10m. final status: mitigated, monitoring, customer notified, temporary knobs applied (`max_batch_tokens=1024`, `scheduler.concurrency_limit=8`, `rate_limit=120rps`, `isolate_queue=true`).
incident-bot: Incident resolved? set status to monitoring to track recurrence. :white_check_mark:
Mara J: setting status -> monitoring. will drop notes into incident tracker and link to ticket 8342.
Devon L: thanks all. follow-up actions: permanent config, run replay tests, add canary policy.
